acceptance_criteria: A joining character appears on the SpawnLocation at (18, 0.3, 32) facing the Great Egg Tree before the profile loads; nobody is moved to a gate at join; `play` moves the loaded player to Plots.gate and is refused while racing; `home` unchanged (Studio, two clients, build stamp)

GardenProgress.login counts the day at load; a UTC day change while online applies loginTick once per session (clock moved in Studio: the WEEKLY card count rises without rejoining); the tick never counts a day twice across a flush re-apply
Router: `claimLogin week|month` pays through Profiles.request and sets LastReward; any other arg refused; `claimDaily` and `claimWeekly` are unknown actions; the 0.35 s limit applies

World.build adds the spawn pad, 12 large sakura at the X2 positions with the small-sakura thinning, the three hill bands (terrain near, hill_a/b/c meshes mid and far with part fallbacks), the pond at (-50, 0, -92) with lily pads, 24 lanterns in the lamps list lit at Moonfall, 900 flowers and the plaza boxes; plots, cart, boards, Splash Island and the Petal Patch positions unchanged; Workspace.Garden Parts attribute under 7,500

verification: CI build and check-place; A15 playtest note with the build stamp (spawn, PLAY, rollover, claim, valley screenshots)
notes: The join-time toGate (GardenServer onPlayer and the CharacterAdded fallback) is removed, not kept beside the SpawnLocation; Dash.place stays.
